Package com.codeup.novabook.util

package com.codeup.novabook.util
Utility classes providing common functionality across the NovaBook system.

This package contains utility classes that provide reusable functionality for various aspects of the application:

  • ValidationUtils: Comprehensive input validation utilities for users, vehicles, rentals, and other domain objects
  • PasswordUtils: Secure password hashing and verification using BCrypt algorithm

All utility classes are designed as static utility classes with private constructors to prevent instantiation, following the utility class pattern.
